title: Casse-Robot melee weapon
description: A melee weapon: a mass that spins or an arm that strikes, carried by a block (nothing is fired). One file per melee weapon: content/melee/<id>.json, named after the weapon's identifier (a block type's `melee`), read by the game as it is (src/shared/catalog/melee.ts). Adding a melee weapon also takes its block, its models, its sight, its sounds and its name in each language in the client (docs/architecture.md, "Architecture rules"). Generated from the game's code (npm run schemas). Units: meters, kilograms, seconds, radians, newtons.

$schema.description: The schema of this file's family (content/schemas/<family>.schema.json), relative to the file, for the editor of whoever edits it. The game ignores it, like every field whose name starts with `$`.

$comment.description: A note for whoever edits this file (why the values are what they are). The game ignores it.

look.description: Its look (drawing, sound, effects in the client).

motion.description: Its motion: a rotor, a rotor driven by its block's engine, a triggered arm, a point that thrusts, a field around the hull, a plate that lifts, a ball on a chain, a jaw that grips.

axis.description: Axis of the rotor or of the arm's pivot, in the block's frame (up +y, left +x, forward +z).

hub.description: The hub (center of the rotor, or the arm's pivot), in the block's frame (m).

drive.description: A rotor driven by an engine: its speed follows the thrust.

idle.description: Speed at idle (share of full speed).

stop.description: Below this share of the maximum thrust (engine off), it stops.

bite.description: A rotor that bites continuously instead of striking (saw, drill).

feed.description: Where the bite goes into the target: the edge of a disc, or the point of a bit.

grab.description: Factor of the cutting force that drags the target along the blade (0: nothing; 1: physical).

gear.description: Reduction between the rotor and the tool (1: direct drive).

depth.description: Depth (m) to which the damage left by a pierced block goes on to the next.

swing.description: A triggered arm: its head goes from `rest` to `end` around the axis (angles: 0 straight ahead, π/2 toward the block's top), then comes back.

reach.description: Distance from the pivot to the head (m).

end.description: Angle at the end of the strike (rad).

energy.description: Energy of the head at the end of its course (J).

cost.description: Energy a strike takes from the batteries (kJ).

plate.description: A flipper's plate: a ram lifts it from `rest` to `end` and throws what is on it.

rest.description: Angle at rest (rad; negative: wedged toward the ground).

end.description: Angle at the end of the lift (rad).

reload.description: The ram is ready again this long after the lift (s).

energy.description: Work of the ram over its whole course (J).

cost.description: Energy a lift takes from the batteries (kJ).

flail.description: A flail: a ball on a chain hung from a crank that the motor turns.

inertia.description: Inertia of the crank and hub (kg·m²): its gyroscope.

speed.description: Speed of the crank at full (rad/s).

restitution.description: Bounce of the ball (0: soft; 1: elastic).

friction.description: Share of its speed along what it hits that it keeps.

drag.description: Air drag on the ball (share of its speed lost per second).

jaw.description: A crusher jaw: two jaws that close on what is in their mouth, crush it and drag it.

length.description: Length of the jaws from their pivot (m).

mouth.description: The mouth: between these distances from the pivot (m), what is there can be gripped.

strength.description: Force the grip holds (N); beyond, it slips.

slip.description: After this much slipping (s), it lets go.

tear.description: Gap (m) between the two points of the grip beyond which it tears off.

crush.description: Damage per second of the crushing.

bite.description: Damage of the bite that grips.

power.description: Power of the ram while it squeezes (kW).

thrust.description: A point that thrusts out along the block's front, then retracts.

retracted.description: Distance of the point from the hub, retracted (m).

reach.description: Distance of the point from the hub, out (m).

cost.description: Energy a thrust takes from the batteries (kJ).

field.description: A field around the hull of its part: it strikes what comes into a margin around the blocks.

radius.description: It covers the blocks within this radius of the projector (m).

contacts.description: Contacts struck per hit, at most.

drain.description: Share of its energy an enemy rotor rubbing against it loses per hit.

repel.description: Impulse that pushes back an enemy melee weapon, per hit (N·s).

quench.description: An energy weapon that goes out without power or under water.

engage.description: Distance at which the AI engages with it (m, between the robots' centers).

damageType.description: A kind of damage: kinetic (bullets), pierce (armor-piercing), explosive, impact (collisions, hammers), fire, energy (lasers: heavy armor doesn't stop it better), cut (blades).

blade.description: The volume a rotor's blade sweeps: a thick ring around its axis.

inner.description: Inner radius (m); 0 for a bar or a disc.

half.description: Half thickness along the axis (m). Longer than `outer`: a drill bit, its hub in the middle of its length.

arms.description: The blade's arms (a bar: two; a propeller: three): its hitbox turns with them.

web.description: The web joining a ring to its hub (a shell spinner's spokes): a disc of radius `outer`, that doesn't strike.

at.description: Center along the axis from the hub (m).

spin.description: A rotor: its inertia and full speed give its stored energy (½·I·ω²) and its angular momentum.

spinUp.description: Time from rest to full speed at full motor power (s): the motor's power follows from it.

spinDown.description: Free spin: the speed loses two thirds (1/e) in this time (s); holding full speed costs these losses.

gyro.description: Factor of the gyroscopic effect on the robot (1: physical; 0: none).

unbalance.description: Imbalance: offset (m) of the spinning mass of a rotor at 0 hit points.

mass.description: Spinning mass (kg), for the imbalance (included in the block's mass).

direction.description: Direction of rotation around the axis (1: counter-clockwise seen from the end of the axis).

reaction.description: Share of its motor's reaction the robot receives (1: physical; 0: nothing really spins, an energy blade).

damage.description: Damage per kJ of the hit (before resistance).

bite.description: Share of a rotor's stored energy a clean hit takes.

fling.description: Share of the hit's energy that throws the target (the rest tears it).

push.description: Direction of the impulse at the point hit.

recoil.description: Share of the impulse sent back to its own robot, at the hub.

spread.description: Share of the damage the neighboring blocks receive.

wheels.description: Damage factor on wheels and track rollers.

wear.description: Wear: hit points the weapon loses per kJ of hit, divided by the resistance of what it hits.

minSpeed.description: Speed below which a rotor no longer bites (share of full speed); for a flail, the speed of the ball (m/s) below which it only pushes.

ground.description: Share of a clean hit a rotor's hit on the ground takes (0.4 when absent).

ignite.description: Chance to set fire to the block hit.

stun.description: A local stun of the organs around the point hit.
